_about: Notifiable events this engine has that the newest release tag does not. test/validate-posture-and-docs-parity.ts derives that set from NOTIFY_EVENT_NAMES at HEAD and at the tag, and this list must equal it exactly. The docs document released engines only, so each event listed here owes a docs alert-events row that merges once the release that carries the event is tagged. The release commit clears this list, and its cut checks each listed event's docs change.
